basics.name: Kina (Gi Yeon) Kim
basics.Title: Software Engineer, Applied ML
basics.summary: I build machine learning for database systems on the Db2 Query Optimization team at IBM, with research interests in ML reliability, evaluation, and robustness.

work.name: IBM — Db2 Query Optimization
highlights: Conducting an empirical study of how to represent and search large spaces of equivalent query transformations, comparing structured representations, learned embeddings, and optimization methods such as Bayesian optimization for integration into the Db2 query compiler.
Building ML training infrastructure embedded within Db2 to support model training and deployment directly alongside the database engine.

work.name: AI4Good at Mila
highlights: Investigated how gender bias encoded in learned language representations can propagate into occupation classification, and implemented an adversarial debiasing approach that reduced TPR disparity across demographic groups by 23% while keeping accuracy within 2% of baseline.
Presented the methodology and findings to researchers at Vector Institute and Mila, as well as industry mentors.
The project was later selected for continued support through a sister program after a separate proposal submission.

work.name: IBM — Db2 on Cloud
highlights: Built a Graph VAE framework to generate 1,000+ semantically diverse SQL variants around known failure cases, enabling validation across a neighborhood of related inputs rather than a single reported instance.
Architected testing infrastructure for Db2 on Cloud across AWS and Azure, ensuring 99.9% reliability for 500+ enterprise customers.
Designed RESTful API contracts and implemented backend services in Go/Ruby with gRPC-based dispatching for new cloud backup features.

work.name: Royal Bank of Canada
highlights: Scoped and led an ML project predicting customer churn, presenting a prototype model that was integrated into business operations.
Used Hadoop and SQL for ETL and large-scale dataset analysis.

work.name: IBM — Db2
work.summary: Generative Testing · Anomaly Detection · ML Systems
highlights: Trained a syntax-aware GAN to generate realistic SQL queries for reliability and performance testing of large-scale distributed databases.
Built an Isolation Forest model over distributed Db2 logs, achieving 72% precision in fault prediction and reducing incident response time by 8%.
